THE ASSIGNMENT
ContextContributionRelated expertise

Regional Technical Assistance Project RETA 7743, Phases I–III

The question
behind the work.

The TA helps participating developing member countries strengthen institutional and statistical capacity to collect, compile and disseminate internationally comparable Financial Soundness Indicators.

Analytical contribution.

  1. 01

    Assessed national accounts activities with focus on financial intermediation sectors and financial balance sheet information for 400 non-financial corporations across major economic sectors in five divisions.

  2. 02

    Designed Indicator Development Guidelines for Bangladesh Bank and the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics for compiling and analyzing Financial Soundness Indicators.
